title: UniProt/Swiss-Prot protein database builder
description: Download reproducible taxon-scoped UniProtKB protein FASTA files and build DIAMOND databases.

build_manifest.description: TSV manifest describing one or more UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot database builds.

uniprot_api.description: UniProtKB search endpoint. Override only for a compatible mirror or test service.

page_size.description: Number of FASTA records requested per paginated UniProt response.

use_containers.description: Run the downloader and DIAMOND builder in their configured containers.

tool_containers.description: Container references for the Python downloader and DIAMOND builder.

outdir.description: Output directory. Each build is written beneath databases/<build_id>/.

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports and trace files.
